scope: Offline research only — these are independent proposed requirements, not validated medical-device claims.

contracts.claim: Stock AutoSet pressure control and classification unaffected by inactive add-ons
Disabling Custom VAuto produces stock VAuto control outputs
contracts.native_coverage: Selected wrapper pass-through and lifecycle cases VAUTO-01 through VAUTO-10
contracts.evidence_needed: Full stock-reference inputs and scheduling equivalence

contracts.claim: Custom support respects the independently defined selected-Max-IPAP ceiling
contracts.native_coverage: Seeded and learned VAuto pressure traces evaluated independently at stock-limiter entry
contracts.evidence_needed: Pressure-policy decision; stock final-limiter reference and hardware measurement

contracts.claim: Backup breaths cannot be inadvertently disabled by patch defaults
AutoEPAP Off has identical effects to native iVAPS behaviour
contracts.evidence_needed: Stock timing and ventilation-estimator differential trace

contracts.claim: All injected worker allocations handle low-memory conditions without crash
contracts.evidence_needed: Native fault injection and firmware scheduler observation

contracts.claim: Malformed or non-finite sensor values cannot produce non-finite pressure commands
contracts.native_coverage: AutoEPAP target fault; VAuto internal nonfinite state and already-invalid stock waveform
contracts.evidence_needed: Sensor-to-output reachability and downstream fault handling

contracts.claim: Controller state resets across mode changes and aborts
contracts.native_coverage: VAuto activation/toggle/stop/requested-mode cases VAUTO-04 through VAUTO-11
contracts.evidence_needed: Tracker lifecycle and real scheduler integration

contracts.claim: Pressure transitions and fall/rise timing stay within independently defined limits
contracts.evidence_needed: Reference timing and HIL pressure transducer

contracts.claim: EDF channels and reported mode match actual delivered therapy
